suppliers.title: Suppliers · KYC
suppliers.subtitleNone: Suppliers of the company you choose · verify before first payment
suppliers.formHelp: GSTIN, PAN and Udyam come from the supplier's certificates. The bank account is added on the supplier's page after saving.
suppliers.rightsNote: You see and change suppliers as your rights allow. Bank changes need a second person.
suppliers.viewOnly: You can see suppliers but not change them. Ask Admin for the purchase rights.
suppliers.listFoot: More suppliers come in with the Tally import (Admin › Import data), each as a draft to verify.
suppliers.emptyBody: Add a supplier, or load the supplier masters from Tally (Admin › Import data).
suppliers.noCompanies: No companies set up yet. Admin adds them on Companies.
suppliers.bankNote: Confirm the account by phone on a known number before the first payment. Any later change needs a second person's approval.
suppliers.bankPendingNote: A bank change is waiting: a second person must record the call-back to a known number and approve it before any payment to the new account.
suppliers.billsLater: Bills from this supplier arrive with purchase in Phase 4.
suppliers.bankInDetail: After saving, add the bank account on the supplier's page; it is checked by a cancelled cheque or a penny-drop.

msme.title: MSME status
msme.limitedBody: Pay each bill within the agreed period, at most 45 days from acceptance. The ERP warns before the due date and lists overdue MSME payables.
msme.caNote: Unpaid past the limit, the expense can't be claimed until paid. The CA confirms the treatment.
msme.mediumBody: Medium enterprise: the 45-day limit does not apply. The agreed terms decide the due date.
msme.unknownBody: MSME status not known. Ask for the Udyam certificate: micro and small suppliers must be paid within 45 days.

err.legalName: Enter the legal name as on the GST or PAN certificate.
